name: Home / Search Hero
description: The home page: full-bleed hero with headline and the flight search widget overlapping its bottom, then destinations, cabin highlights and a promo panel.

provenance.tag: Live (hero headline: Heroic-Medium 120px). Search widget: A · unverified. Section order: Rec.

structure:
[Hero: full-bleed photo, --radius-none]
  [display-xl / display-lg headline on --color-overlay-image gradient]
  [FlightSearchWidget — Card, --elevation-3, overlaps the bottom of the hero]
[Section: DestinationGrid]
[Section: Cabin highlights — CabinFeatureCard ×4]
[PromoPanel — cream, --radius-panel]

FlightSearchWidget:
[SegmentedControl: Return | One way | Multi-city]
[From ⇄ To] [Departure – Return dates] [Passengers & Cabin] [Search →]

regions.name: Hero
regions.description: Full-bleed photo, --radius-none. display-xl / display-lg headline on the --color-overlay-image gradient. Heroic-Medium falls back to the base stack (D7).

regions.name: Flight search
regions.description: FlightSearchWidget in a Card with --elevation-3, overlapping the bottom of the hero. Trip type, From ⇄ To, dates, passengers & cabin, Search.

responsive.behavior: The search widget collapses to a single "Search flights" field that opens a full-screen overlay.
display-xl headline; below lg it uses display-lg.
